notes.title: image2pixel v1.7.1
notes.content:
image2pixel v1.7.1 
- The Pixelelizer algorithm now allows you to disable grid preview.
- The result window supports zooming in and out using the mouse wheel.

notes.title: Image2pixel v1.4
notes.content:
Image2pixel v1.4.0

- Added 1bit algorithm for monochrome pixel art generation using Bayer dithering
- Enhanced algorithm selection with three distinct modes: Standard, SLIC Superpixel, and 1bit
- Improved user interface with optimized parameter layouts for different algorithms
- Added support for grayscale and high-contrast artistic styles

notes.title: Image2pixel v1.3.3
notes.content:
Image2pixel v1.3.3

[list]
[*] Automatically saves an additional 1x1 pixel version for non-GIF images, providing a true pixel representation alongside the upscaled artwork.
[*] Optimized transparent images
[/list]

notes.title: Image2pixel v1.3.2
notes.content:

Improved alpha channel handling in all pixelation algorithms
Enhanced image quality preservation for images with transparency

notes.title: Image2pixel v1.3.0
notes.content:
Hi, Image2pixel users! Today we have released a new version, including multiple fixes and some minor improvements:

v1.3.0

Added SLIC (Simple Linear Iterative Clustering) algorithm for superpixel-based pixel art generation
Improved error handling with Toast notifications
Enhanced algorithm parameter management
Modified algorithm default values to reduce difficulty for beginners

notes.title: Image2pixel v1.2.0
notes.content:
Hi, Image2pixel users! Today we have a new version release, including multiple fixes and some minor improvements:

v1.2.0

[list]
[*] Added custom palette import function (supports .act format)
[*] Improved palette management
[*] Enhanced user interface
[*] Support for drag and drop image import
[*] Support for shortcuts:
[/list]
[olist]
[*] Open image windows:Ctrl+O/macOS:Command+O
[*] Save image windows:Ctrl+S/macOS:Command+S
[/olist]
